final_netlist:
.subckt dut iin vout vdd vss ibias
* bias: IREF (10uA) diode and NMOS mirrors (L=1)
Mb0  ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=4.2  L=1
Mbp  pd    ibias vss vss nfet W=0.42 L=1
* PMOS bias diode (1uA) + RC noise filter (larger area -> lower 1/f)
Mp0  pd pd vdd vdd pfet W=1 L=1
Rpb  pd pb 1MEG
Cpb  pb vdd 5p
* gain stage: CS NMOS with PMOS current-source load (14uA), larger-area load
Mp1  x  pb  vdd vdd pfet W=1 L=1 m=14
M1   x  iin vss vss nfet W=6   L=0.3
* feedback follower (3uA) and feedback resistor (raised for lower noise)
Mf1  vdd x  y   vss nfet W=2    L=0.15
Mbf1 y   ibias vss vss nfet W=1.26 L=1
Rf   y   iin 400k
* output follower (6uA) driving CL
Mf2  vdd x  vout vss nfet W=10   L=0.15
Mbf2 vout ibias vss vss nfet W=2.52 L=1
.ends
